race.title: Safer Gambling Week 2026 Handicap (0-60)
race.verdict: YOUNG CHURCHILL was unlucky not to finish closer to Doctor Grace when that rival was successful here a week ago and he looks a sporting bet to reverse the form this time. Tintinabulla is also of interest, while Lisnadill requires a market check. YOUNG CHURCHILL (IRE) DOCTOR GRACE (IRE) TINTINABULLA (IRE)
